sections.heading: Why visit Ooty
paragraphs: Ooty (Tamil Nadu) is known for its hills, family and nature experiences. Overall it is mid-range — comfortable stays and good food without overspending.

sections.heading: Best time to go
paragraphs: The best time to visit is October to June.

paragraphs: Coimbatore airport is about 3 hours away; the toy train runs from Mettupalayam.
